finding: A pre-commit invocation with no staged files auto-removed generated bundle manifests belonging to previously released tasks. The cleanup is observable but is outside the current candidate and can mutate a shared worktree during an otherwise read/validate operation.
expectedBehavior: Automatic cleanup must be candidate- or explicitly-owned-scope bounded. Cross-task generated residue should be reported as a separately actionable cleanup batch, not silently mutated by an unrelated hook invocation. Any cleanup write must carry an owner, receipt, and exact-path attribution.
evidenceOrRepro: 2026-08-14 source-first node atm.dev.mjs hook pre-commit --json after commit 7e7573c5149a2f83e84b9424aee2ea4c00216718 passed in 4314 ms with stagedFileCount 0, while reporting ATM_HOOK_AUTO_CLEANED_GENERATED_RESIDUE for 22 released-task bundle-manifest files (including ATM-GOV-0298 through ATM-GOV-0383 and TASK-ERR-0014).
followUp: Move residue deletion to an explicit, task-owned cleanup command or bounded post-transaction finalizer. Preserve the fast hook budget by reporting cleanup candidates without writing them, and add a shared-worktree regression proving an empty-candidate hook never changes foreign paths.
